Bid my true value of $9. In a second-price sealed-bid auction, bidding your value is a dominant strategy: you win whenever the second-highest bid is below your value and pay that price, ensuring nonnegative payoff when winning. No prior history to exploit; values are independent each round, so truthful bidding maximizes expected long-run profit.
